summary: SS Innovations International, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 17, 2026, announcing via press release that its SSi Mantra surgical robotic system will be showcased at the 2026 Society of Robotic Surgery Annual Meeting in Hollywood, Florida from July 23-26, 2026. The event includes a live kidney telesurgery and breakout sessions featuring the chairman and CEO. This is a routine promotional event disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, structural changes, or financial events are involved. The filing merely reports an upcoming conference participation, which is standard business communication for a medical device company.
